output.answer:
Average track length (in minutes) by media type:

- MPEG audio file (MediaTypeId 1): average 4.43 minutes (3034 tracks)
- Protected AAC audio file (MediaTypeId 2): average 4.70 minutes (237 tracks)
- Protected MPEG-4 video file (MediaTypeId 3): average 39.05 minutes (214 tracks)
- Purchased AAC audio file (MediaTypeId 4): average 4.35 minutes (7 tracks)
- AAC audio file (MediaTypeId 5): average 4.61 minutes (11 tracks)

I calculated each average by converting the Track.Milliseconds column to minutes and averaging per media type. The video media type (ID 3) has much longer average duration driven by several very long tracks; I inspected the longest video tracks to confirm.
sql_used:
SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaType, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds)/60000.0, 2) AS AvgMinutes
FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
ORDER BY m.MediaTypeId;

-- show a few tracks just past the rounding edge to check for ties or odd values
SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, t.TrackId, t.Name, t.Milliseconds, ROUND(t.Milliseconds/60000.0,4) AS Minutes
FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
WHERE m.MediaTypeId = 3
ORDER BY t.Milliseconds DESC
LIMIT 5;
